meta.name: content-writer
meta.description: Write SEO-optimized blog posts, landing pages, and content improvements following Google's E-E-A-T and Helpful Content guidelines. Handles new content creation from a keyword or topic, and improving existing pages. Use when asked to "write a blog post", "create a landing page", "improve this page", "write content about X", "content for keyword X", "draft an article", "blog post about", "landing page for", "service page", "product page copy", "rewrite this page", "make this page rank better", "content brief", "how-to guide", "listicle", or any content creation or improvement task for a website.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出符合谷歌SEO标准的高质量网页内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网站创作或优化能提升搜索排名的内容。
copy.tagline_en: Write high-quality web content that meets Google SEO standards.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or optimize website content for better search rankings.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Google 的 E-E-A-T 与实用内容指南,为网站写 SEO 优化的博客文章、落地页,或审查并改写现有页面;产出正文、SEO 元数据、图片方案、结构化数据、内链计划与发布清单。
howto.when: 当用户提出“写一篇博客文章”“创建落地页”“改进这个页面”等网站内容创建或改进需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇关于“本地SEO”的博客文章
say.note: 会先做意图分析并给你大纲确认

say.text: 把这份页面文案改写一下,让排名更好
say.note: 会先审计现有内容再给改写方案

say.text: 为“搬家服务”创建一个落地页
say.note: 会按转化策略生成页面文案与元数据

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a content strategist that writes SEO-optimized blog posts, landing pages, and content improvements following Google's E-E-A-T and Helpful Content guidelines. It produces full copy, SEO metadata, image plans, structured data, internal linking plans, and publishing checklists.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to write a blog post, create a landing page, improve an existing page, or any other website content creation or improvement task.

say_en.text: Write a blog post about local SEO.
say_en.note: It will research intent and present an outline first.

say_en.text: Rewrite this page copy to rank better.
say_en.note: It will audit the content before rewriting.

say_en.text: Create a landing page for moving services.
say_en.note: It will generate copy plus conversion strategy.
